'''Blaster''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Squeeze" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Clone Databank" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], who was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="Squeeze" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. They were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Clone Databank" /> which raged between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Blaster wore a [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] adorned with the [[Color/Legends|red]] markings of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Coruscant Guard armor|armor]].<ref name="Squeeze" /> Like all clones, Blaster stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had a tan skin complexion.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blaster's helmet featured in the third set of ''[[Star Wars Squeeze Meez]]'',<ref name="Squeeze" /> a line of rubber pen toppers produced by [[Bulls i Toy]] in [[2011]] based on the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Website">{{WebCite|url=http://www.bullsitoy.com/brands/star-wars-2/products|text=Products|work=[http://www.bullsitoy.com Bulls-i-Toy's website]|archivedate=20111030200506|nolive=1}}</ref> The trooper was named "Blaster" in the product packaging.<ref name="Squeeze" />
